Dombon, szabadon álló, keletelt, egyhajós, nyugati homlokzati tornyos templom, a hajó északi oldalához csatlakozó sekrestyével. A hajó D-i oldalán két, beton támpillér. Kapuja, ablakai kőkeretesek. Categories.value: Hindu temples in West Bengal|Self-published work|Mahesh Jagannath Temple

ImageDescription.value: It is the site of a 14th century temple of Lord Jagannath (জগন্নাথ মন্দির), and the Rathayatra of Mahesh, which first took place in 1397, is the second oldest in India. The Rathayatra of Mahesh (Bengali: মাহেশের রথযাত্রা) is the second oldest rathayatra in the world and the oldest and biggest in Bengal, having been celebrated since 1396. It is held in Mahesh, a historical locality within Serampore City (শ্রীরামপুর) in the Indian state of West Bengal. The Shrirampur railway station nearest rail station of this place.
